question: Whom should the practitioner meditate upon and honor in this context?
premises: Meditation on the guru is prescribed
Those of the guru's kind or lineage are included
inference: One should meditate on the guru and honor those belonging to his lineage
uncertainties: Scope of tajjātīyān as lineage, disciples, or similar beings
plain_english: One should meditate on the guru and honor those of his lineage.
